rows.grounds: locative/demonstrative adverb indicating the present point in the text
compound denoting the conclusion of a paṭala (chapter)

items.question: Is a formal conclusion of the chapter present at this point in the text?
premises: atra indicates the present location in the text.
paṭalasamāptiḥ denotes the completion of a chapter.
na asti explicitly negates the existence of that completion.
items.inference: No formal chapter conclusion occurs at this point.
items.plain_english: Here there is no conclusion of the chapter.
